description: Source code for a video decoder class implementing VP9 decoding using libvpx, with support for decode-to-texture mode and managing decode targets.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class that handles VP9 video decoding using libvpx, supporting decode-to-texture mode and managing decode targets.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video decoder with codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: ~VideoDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that resets the decoder state.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callback functions.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder, flushing remaining frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, stopping decoding and clearing frames.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with the current frame in decode-to-texture mode.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the libvpx VP9 decoder context.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Destroys the decoder context and releases decode targets.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer and creates a video frame.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target in decode-to-texture mode.
